title: Huh? (Cat)
blurb: A small bewildered noise, and the audio equivalent of a head tilt. Attached to the famous confused cat image, it captures the exact instant comprehension fails — not disagreement, not objection, simply the machinery failing to engage with what it has just been given. Use it when somebody says something structurally impossible, when instructions contradict themselves halfway down the page, or when you check a bank balance you had a rough estimate of and were wrong. Tiny sound, enormous and slightly upsetting relatability.
origin: Paired with the viral confused cat meme; the sound of pure bafflement.
